articles.title: Democrats Take Control of Congress in the Midterm Elections
articles.summary: Democrats won control of the House and Senate in the midterms, setting up closer checks on President Trump in his final two years in office.

articles.title: Nine Governor Races Make History Across the Country
articles.summary: Nine states elected history-making governors on Tuesday, including the first Black woman governor, the first Native American woman governor, and first women governors in Tennessee, Minnesota and Ohio.

articles.title: James Talarico Wins Texas Senate Seat, a First for Democrats Since 1988
articles.summary: Former teacher James Talarico won Texas's Senate seat, the first Democrat to do so since 1988, in the most expensive Senate race ever.
